scientific_integrity: The theorem and thresholds are established analytically by Gaussian regression and inverse-gamma/chi-square integrals; finite tests are reproducibility checks, not infinite certificates. Earlier Gaussian ratio theory and sRR construction are credited; independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; one identified non-spectator Ritz eigenvalue; fixed invariant spectator subspace; Gaussian real/complex iid sketches; no numerical root-identification guarantee, no Rayleigh refinement, no generic non-Gaussian law.
title: Sharp real–complex Gaussian oversampling thresholds for sketched Ritz moments
